checks.rationale: AC1 remains incomplete: valid mapped-profile effects start but cannot reconnect after restart (R1-TASK-017-003). AC2 capability, rank, configured:false and invalid observed provenance cases pass; both prior findings are resolved.

The flat Python fake respects REQ-04/AC-04 and exclusions: no production provider, network authority, canonical journal, intents, lease admission, review-gate implementation or new v1 fields. The finding is within existing recovery behavior.

Whole-request idempotency and identity fences pass. First terminal poll/result and confirmed cancellation now remain stable. The new provider-name equality rejects valid effects previously admitted through the accepted settings mapping.

Atomic replacement failures roll back start, scripting, polling and cancellation without leaked temporary files. Invalid observed facts do not advance cursors. Restoration nevertheless fails for a valid unchanged mapped configuration, preventing required sequential recovery.

Independent temporal exploration admits all 249 reachable combinations and rejects 1363 impossible cursor/last/quiescence combinations across 35 script pairs. Empty, late, exhausted, partial and unconsumed fault scripts work. Valid non-identity profile mapping is the remaining recovery edge failure.

Exact declared Windows Python 3.12.14 leaf independently ran 27 tests, exit 0; committed candidate binds matching Windows/Linux Python 3.11.16 evidence. Owned tests meaningfully cover repaired temporal/corruption cases, but their same-name synthetic profiles miss the supported mapping that fails with the real accepted loader.

The optional single-owner provider backing file is explicitly dispatched, simulation-owned and separate from TASK-009/010 workflow state. No downstream owner, shared contract, registry, public Protocol or schema is implemented or changed.

Native Git confirms exact clean head and frozen merge-base, with only agents.py, its owned test leaf and handoff added. Raw diff, 14 committed contexts, 3 ROOT validation hashes, policy/model digest and fingerprint match; r4 task and structural graph digests independently match approval.

The explicit agents submodule uses accepted immutable request/result values and frozen start/poll/cancel signatures. Configuration/capabilities are injected; tuples detach scripts, and persistence/rollback stays localized. The defect has a bounded implementation correction without new abstractions or prerequisite edits.

No credentials, network calls, native-setting reads or automatic promotion of configured:false were found. 22 changed request fields and 18 changed handle cases fail closed; five model mutations remain rejected after restoration without cursor movement. Simulation metadata distinguishes submitted effort from unavailable provider-observed effort. The new defect is a false rejection, not an authority bypass.

Handoff accurately records prior failures, repair behavior, local validation limitations and one-owner simulation boundaries. Its general reconnection claim for unchanged saved settings is too broad while valid policy-to-provider profile mappings cannot restore. Update evidence alongside the bounded correction.

findings.description: src/agents.py:885 newly requires configured_model.name == request.model_profile during restoration. Accepted TASK-038 ProjectSettings.configured_model resolves policy_profile_map, whose policy and provider profile names may differ. A real schema-validated source fixture maps implementation to implementation_custom with the identical provider/model/rank/effort, configured:true and adequate review rank. start, exact retry and queued poll succeed in the first Python process, but a second fresh process with byte-identical settings fails FakeAgentProviderState construction with validation_failed. The identity-mapping control recovers the same single effect. A successfully started fake effect thus becomes unrecoverable after coordinator/process loss despite valid unchanged saved settings.
findings.expected_fix: Preserve the distinction between the requested policy profile and the resolved configured provider profile when validating restored state. Check their relationship through the injected accepted policy_profile_map/configured_model binding, retaining the existing exact stored model/effort/identity checks. Add an owned regression using a valid non-identity mapping through the accepted configuration loader and a fresh-process restart; do not change TASK-038, frozen ports or schemas.
